notes.title: Demo available
notes.notes: The difference from the full version is the absence of top weapons. For this reason, completely reaching the final is incredibly difficult. However, if you select the “City” menu item, you can go directly to the final location. There you can check out the bonus game that is offered after completing the adventure. This is a kind of homeless simulator, an imitation of survival in a city where everything you need is available only for money. A character who has completed the main story has the ability to maintain his existence for free and save money. In particular, you can buy a ticket back to the island. However, without skills and equipment there will be an acute shortage of money. However, you will get some idea of ​​what awaits you in the full game.

notes.title: Announcement for Russian-speaking audience
notes.notes:
Story-based RPG with survival elements. To achieve the goal, the hero must search for equipment, develop combat and special skills, but at the same time he is forced to fight thirst, hunger and fatigue. In all matters, his culinary abilities greatly help him. The food and drinks he prepares work no worse than magical elixirs. Food resources are reproducible but susceptible to spoilage. Advanced recipes allow you to cook food with a long shelf life, and there are also refrigerators in the game. This is a big and long adventure, the longer you live on the island, the stronger your character will be.
In the finale, the hero ends up in his hometown, and a bonus game awaits you there. You can’t pitch a tent or make a fire there, and everything you need is available for money that you don’t have. The city is endless with random content that provides the opportunity to survive and earn money. Essentially, this is a homeless simulator, a philosophical reason to compare life in nature and in the city.

notes.title: Meet the new project
notes.notes:
Z-Factor is a role-playing game with survival elements. To successfully advance through the plot, the heromust provide himself with food and shelter. Food and drinks prepared according to recipes, work similarly to magical elixirs and provide a noticeable increase in combat characteristics.

Character development depends on the player's actions. Based on the statistics of your actions, progress for each individual skill is counted, and the maximum possible level is limited only by the limits of common sense. There is no division into classes, you can watch your progress and change your behavior in the game, so that the desired skill develops faster. Mechanics that are familiar to Morrowind and Fallout players are used, but in no case are theyabout copying or imitating these projects.

There are other features that can be found quite rarely.

The crosshair of the sight serves as a kind of sensory organ that helps predict the situation. You can simply look at each object from afar, or you can carefully study it up close.All objects contain textual information, so the world around them conducts a dialogue with the character. When you take a quick look from afar, you only see a short name, but if you come closer and applyscientific skill, you can find out some details. The more important the secret contained in the object,the higher the skill must be to learn it. In some cases this is critical forprogression through the plot. When an object has already been studied, when looking from afar, the cursor turns green if the gaze falls onhostile creature, the crosshair turns red.

The character has a certain reserve of stamina, which is spent on all active actions. In real-time combat, it works like action points in turn-based combat. Recovery speedendurance depends significantly on the food and drinks consumed. All food products are susceptiblespoilage, more complex recipes allow you to prepare food with a longer shelf life, in some locations you can use a refrigerator.

The main point of the game is time and resource management. If used rationally, resources will be inin excess, otherwise problems will arise.
